prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: I can’t name a single objectively “best” lawyer — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case (injury severity, liability issues, insurance limits, whether you want to go to trial, language preference, etc.). However, I can help you find top-rated Miami personal injury attorneys who handle car-accident cases and tell you how to choose among them.

What to look for in a Miami car-accident lawyer
- Experience with car-accident cases and similar injuries (whiplash to catastrophic injuries).  
- Trial experience and a record of settlements/verdicts for plaintiffs.  
- Contingency-fee representation (no recovery, no fee) and clear explanation of fees and costs.  
- Willingness to coordinate medical care and manage medical liens.  
- Good communication: prompt updates, a clear point of contact.  
- Local knowledge of Miami-Dade courts, judges and insurance adjusters.  
- Positive client reviews and strong peer ratings (AVVO, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers).  
- Proper licensing and no disciplinary history (check the Florida Bar).

Reputable Miami-area firms you can consider (examples)
- Colson Hicks Eidson (Miami Beach) — plaintiff-oriented, handles serious car-accident and catastrophic injury cases.  
- Morgan & Morgan — large nationwide plaintiff firm with a Miami presence; often handles auto-injury claims.  
- Steinger, Greene & Feiner — Florida personal injury firm with experience in car accidents.  
- Lipcon, Margulies & Winkleman — Miami trial lawyers with plaintiff-side experience.

(These are examples of established firms; they’re not an exhaustive ranking. You should confirm current reviews and track records.)

Questions to ask during a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine before? What were the outcomes?  
- Who will work on my case day-to-day? Will I deal directly with the attorney or a paralegal?  
- Do you take cases on contingency? What percentage and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- What is your estimated timeline and likely range of compensation?  
- Do you have trial experience if my case goes to court?  
- How will you communicate with me and how often?

If you want, I can:
- Find and list 3–5 top-rated car-accident attorneys in Miami with addresses, phone numbers, and average review scores; or  
- Help you draft a brief summary of your case so you’re ready for consultations.

Tell me your ZIP code, any language preference (e.g., Spanish), and a little about the accident (injury severity, whether police report exists) and I’ll pull a tailored list.
